title: A2 Milestone 4: Final Exam
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has completado el Nivel A2 (Pre-Intermedio). Has demostrado que puedes comunicarte en un entorno corporativo. ¡Prepárate para el nivel B1!

stages.title: A2 Final Exam: El Gran Reto

parts.visual:
En este examen final evaluaremos tu dominio del Nivel A2: 
- Emails (Reply all, attach) 
- Reported Speech (He said he was busy) 
- Online Meetings (You are on mute, share screen)
parts.audio: Welcome to your A2 Final Exam. We will evaluate your mastery of emails, reported speech, and online meetings.

parts.visual:
- Too vs Enough (Too expensive, big enough) 
- Departments & Roles (HR, IT, CEO, Manager) 
- Office Supplies (Printer, stapler) 
- Obligation & Prohibition (Have to, mustn't) 
- Trends (Go up, slight decrease) 
- Relative Clauses (who, which, where)
parts.audio: We will also test you on quantifiers, company structure, office supplies, modals of obligation, describing trends, and relative clauses. Good luck!

stages.title: Final Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta. Este es tu examen final para el nivel A2.

questions.question: Could you ____ this email to the CEO? (Reenviar).
Please find ____ the report. (Adjunto).

Direct: 'I am busy'. 
Reported: He said that he ____ busy.
She ____ me that the meeting was cancelled. (Me dijo).
I can't hear you. You are on ____. (Silencio).
Let me ____ my screen with you. (Compartir).
The software is ____ complicated. I don't understand it. (Demasiado).
We don't have ____ money to buy a new printer. (Suficiente).
If your computer is broken, call ____. (El departamento de sistemas).
The ____ hires new employees. (Recursos Humanos).
The highest position in the company is the ____. (Director Ejecutivo).
I need to print this. Is the ____ working? (Impresora).
Destroy these documents in the ____. (Trituradora).
You ____ wear a uniform here. It's mandatory. (Tienes que).
You ____ smoke in the office. It's illegal. (Prohibido/No debes).
Sales ____ significantly last year. (Subieron - Pasado de go up).
There was a ____ drop in profits. (Fuerte/Pronunciada).
The man ____ called you is my manager. (Quien/Que).
This is the office ____ we work. (Donde).
The laptop ____ I bought is broken. (Que/La cual).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave del nivel A2.

questions.question: What is the ____ of the email? (Asunto)
He ____ that he was tired. (Dijo - pasado de say)
She ____ me that she liked it. (Dijo - pasado de tell)
It's ____ expensive. (Demasiado)
Not big ____. (Suficiente)
Where is the ____? (Engrapadora)
You ____ to wear a uniform. (Tienes que - obligación)
You ____ smoke here. (No debes - prohibición)
Profits ____ sharply. (Cayeron - pasado de fall)
The man ____ called is the boss. (Quien)
